reviewer.role: Fresh delegated independent source reviewer; no candidate implementation edits

scope: Exact frozen source candidate for one retained uninitialized local loan deployment recovery. No execution authorization or financial/network/proof acceptance.

findings.title: Parallel restore readbacks collide on the production LevelDB lock
findings.description: The final restore gate starts private-state get and signing-key get concurrently. The pinned provider creates a separate new Level handle for every withSubLevel operation against the same database directory; it does not share or serialize handles across these sublevels. A synthetic test with the exact installed provider reproduced one fulfilled read and one LEVEL_DATABASE_NOT_OPEN caused by LEVEL_LOCKED. Both readbacks succeed sequentially. Thus the recovery path can stop after its private writes and before the driver even with valid state, key and password. The in-memory restore observation cannot detect this production failure.
findings.requestedChange: Await provider.get and provider.getSigningKey sequentially, retaining equality checks and the single-use result gate. Add a bounded synthetic production-provider roundtrip regression so the disk-backed lifecycle is exercised.

checks.name: constructor-sdk-path
checks.detail: Installed ContractExecutable.initialize executes the constructor, populates operation verifier keys and original signing-key authority without constructing a new deployment. Helper requires exact complete retained state, empty private state, unchanged key and empty Zswap effects.

checks.name: wallet-sdk-shapes
checks.detail: Compared actual wallet state getters with strict connected/complete checks, available and pending unshielded coin exclusion, old DUST nullifier lookup, empty pendingDust, registered DUST and whole three-call cap at recent indexed time.

checks.name: store-preservation
checks.detail: Inspected exclusive private snapshot creation, pre/post source file digests, root namespace metadata-only check, account hash format matching installed provider, symlink/permission bounds, and isolated empty destination gate. Original store was not read.

checks.name: private-roundtrip
checks.detail: Pinned production-provider synthetic reproduction confirmed concurrent readback LOCK collision; sequential readbacks match.

checks.name: driver-path
checks.detail: Restore is awaited before driver creation/invocation. Recovery SDK exposes only submitCallTx; branch seeds retained identity, observes/compares deploy once, then initialize/accrue/settle. No recovery prepare/deploy/find shortcut.

checks.name: budget-and-evidence
checks.detail: Launch recovery allows exactly three submissions; ordinary launch requires four. Plan pins original allocation/result charge and uses a new journal and allocation. Historical observation adds no reservation. Test adapters remain explicit sourceTestOnly and do not establish acceptance.

checks.name: deadline-cleanup-secrets
checks.detail: Inspected guarded per-operation deadlines, stopped reservations, tracked pending operations, wallet stop and fixed CLI hard exit. Public events/results exclude SDK private/error objects. Timed-out work is not claimed cancelled and containment remains false without outer confirmation.

checks.name: retained-regression-output
checks.detail: Inspected ledger-regression-02.tap terminal summary: 281 tests, 281 pass, 0 fail. These retained source tests did not catch R1 and do not establish recovery execution.

limitations: No original seed, role-secret, wallet-snapshot or original private-store files were read. No original private files were modified.
Only a newly created temporary synthetic private-state provider fixture was written and removed for the scoped lock reproduction; no real keys or secret values were used or retained.
No service start, wallet construction/synchronization, network request, transaction creation/submission, proof operation or real recovery execution was performed.
Retained constructor evidence was inspected as an observation; original-input constructor reconstruction was not independently rerun because private reads were excluded.
Current-chain state, original metadata-only store predicate, synchronized wallet spend exclusion and available DUST remain runtime gates, not established observations.
Direct SDK source hashes were recorded; this is not a complete transitive dependency or infrastructure audit.
Verdict applies only to the exact candidate digest. Fixes require a new candidate and verification.
